Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 al_id alert;
 al_button number;
 al_text varchar2(100);
begin
 al_id := Find_Alert('YESNO_ALERT'); 
 if Id_Null(al_id) then 
 Message('YESNO_ALERT alert does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 else
 al_text := 'Are you sure to merge '||:from_db||' sponsor '||:from_sponsor_id||' into '||:to_db||' sponsor '||:to_sponsor_id;
 set_alert_property('yesno_alert', alert_message_text, al_text);
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then 
 -- Update all tables
 do_update(:from_sponsor_id, :to_sponsor_id);
 end if;
 end if;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 l_db varchar2(20);
 l_spon varchar2(10);
begin
 Default_Value('YES','global.first_time');
 if :global.first_time != 'YES' then
 l_db := :from_db;
 l_spon := :from_sponsor_id;
 :from_db := :to_db;
 :from_sponsor_id := :to_sponsor_id;
 :to_db := l_db;
 :to_sponsor_id := l_spon;
 else

 end if;

 if get_item_property('pb_show_drive2', enabled) = 'TRUE' then

 end if;

 end if;
 if get_item_property('pb_show_drive1', enabled) = 'TRUE' then
 set_item_property('pb_show_drive1',enabled, property_false);
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 l_first varchar2(10);
 l_program varchar2(30);
 l_count number := 0;

 cursor c1 is 
 select s.sponsor_id, s.name, a.street_name, a.address_1, 
 a.address_2, a.usps_id, a.intl_address_1, a.intl_address_2, 
 a.intl_address_3, a.country_name, a.intl_addr_flag
 from sponsors s, addresses a
 where s.status = 'A'
 and s.address_id = a.address_id
 and s.name = :sp_name
 and s.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id --IM# 4821
 order by 1;

begin
 
 :global.first_time := 'YES';
 go_block('sponsor_details');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record;
 l_first := 'TRUE';
 
 --if get_item_property('control_block.pb_usps_id', label) <> 'USPS ID' then
 --set_item_property('control_block.pb_usps_id', label, 'USPS ID');
 --end if;
 
 for z in c1
 loop
 l_count := l_count + 1;
 if l_count > 2 then
 exit;
 end if;
 IF nvl(z.intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y' THEN
 :sponsor_id := z.sponsor_id;
 :name := z.name;
 :street_name := z.intl_address_1;
 :address_1 := z.intl_address_2;
 :address_2 := z.intl_address_3;
 :usps_id := z.country_name;
 ELSE
 :sponsor_id := z.sponsor_id;
 :name := z.name;
 :street_name := z.street_name;
 :address_1 := z.address_1;
 :address_2 := z.address_2;
 :usps_id := z.usps_id; 
 END IF;
 
 begin
 select last_name, first_name
 into :last_name, :first_name
 from sponsor_contacts
 where sponsor_id = :sponsor_id
 and contact_type = 'DC'
 and rownum < 2
 order by last_name, first_name;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 end;
 select program_id into l_program
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = :sponsor_id;
 if l_program not in ('ANTCONV', 'ANT_DRIV', 'ANT_DRIVES') then
 :lt_or_antrim := 'LIFETRAK';
 else
 :lt_or_antrim := 'ANTRIM';
 end if;
 if l_first = 'TRUE' then
 l_first := 'FALSE' ;
 :to_db := :lt_or_antrim;
 :to_sponsor_id := :sponsor_id;
 else
 :from_db := :lt_or_antrim;
 :from_sponsor_id := :sponsor_id;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 
 
 
 first_record;
 --message('2'); pause; -- tmppp
 
 :system.message_level := 25; 
 if :system.cursor_item <> :sp_name then
 if get_item_property('sp_name', enabled) = 'TRUE' then
 item_change('sp_name', 'D');
 end if;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 --item_change('sp_name', 'D'); --- tmppp replace upper code
 set_item_property('pb_show_drive1',enabled, property_true);
 set_item_property('pb_show_drive2',enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('pb_retrieve',enabled, property_false);
 set_item_property('pb_merge',enabled, property_true);

null;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_UPDATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_update(p_from_sponsor_id in varchar2,
 p_to_sponsor_id in varchar2) IS
 l_seq number := 0;
 l_max_seq number := 0;
 l_note_from varchar2(10);
 l_note_to varchar2(10);
 l_contact varchar2(10);
BEGIN
 -- Update all the tables having sponsor_id field
 -- Update FROM p_from_sponsor_id TO p_to_sponsor_id
 -- Also after updating all tables with desired sponsor_id,
 -- delete from sponsors, sponsor_contacts and addresses tables

 --set_application_property(cursor_style,'BUSY');
 --1. Update aux_donations
 begin
 update aux_donations
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating Aux_donations');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --2. Update drive_checklists
 begin
 update drive_checklists
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating Drive_checklists');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --3. Update drive_checklist_template
 begin
 update drive_checklist_template
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating Drive_checklist_template');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --4. Update drive_checklist_template_audit
 begin
 update drive_checklist_template_audit
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating Drive_checklist_template_audit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --5. Update drive_sponsors
 begin
 update drive_sponsors
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating Drive_sponsors');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --6. Update rollover_preferences
 begin
 update rollover_preferences
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating rollover_preferences');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --7. Update rollover_run_log
 begin
 update rollover_run_log
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating rollover_run_log');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --8. Update sponsor_attributes
 begin
 update sponsor_attributes
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating sponsor_attributes');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --9. Update sponsor_preferences
 begin
 update sponsor_preferences
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating sponsor_preferences');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --10. Update temp_drive_sponsors
 begin
 update temp_drive_sponsors
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error updating temp_drive_sponsors');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --11. Update the sponsor contacts table to point the contact person to new sponsor.
 begin
 update sponsor_contacts
 set sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id,
 program_id = 'DONSPMRG'
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error updating sponsor_contacts');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --12. Update the Note ID in Central Notes for Sponsors.
 begin
 l_note_from := null;
 l_note_to := null;
 l_seq := 0;
 l_max_seq := 1;
 select note_id into l_note_from
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;

 if l_note_from is not null then
 select note_id into l_note_to
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id;

 if l_note_to is not null then
 select max(note_sequence)
 into l_seq
 from central_notes
 where note_id = l_note_to;

 select max(note_sequence) into l_max_seq
 from central_notes
 where note_id = l_note_from;

 for z in 1..l_max_seq
 loop
 l_seq := l_seq+1;
 update central_notes
 set note_id = l_note_to,
 note_sequence = l_seq
 where note_id = l_note_from
 and note_sequence = z;
 end loop;
 else
 update sponsors
 set note_id = l_note_from
 where sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then null;
 end;

 --13. Update the Note ID in Central Notes for Sponsor_contacts.
 begin
 l_note_from := null;
 l_note_to := null;
 l_seq := 0;
 l_max_seq := 1;
 select note_id into l_note_from
 from sponsor_contacts
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id
 and contact_type = 'DC'
 and rownum < 2
 order by last_name, first_name;

 if l_note_from is not null then
 select note_id, contact_id into l_note_to, l_contact
 from sponsor_contacts
 where sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id
 and contact_type = 'DC'
 and rownum < 2
 order by last_name, first_name;

 if l_note_to is not null then
 select max(note_sequence)
 into l_seq
 from central_notes
 where note_id = l_note_to;

 select max(note_sequence) into l_max_seq
 from central_notes
 where note_id = l_note_from;

 for z in 1..l_max_seq
 loop
 l_seq := l_seq+1;
 update central_notes
 set note_id = l_note_to,
 note_sequence = l_seq
 where note_id = l_note_from
 and note_sequence = z;
 end loop;
 else
 update sponsor_contacts
 set note_id = l_note_from
 where sponsor_id = p_to_sponsor_id
 and contact_id = l_contact
 and contact_type = 'DC'
 and rownum < 2;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then null;
 end;


 
 -- Now delete the old sponsor records.
 --1. delete sponsor address
 begin
 delete addresses
 where address_id in (select address_id from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id);
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error deleting addresses for sponsors');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --2. delete sponsor_contacts address
 begin
 delete addresses
 where address_id in (select address_id from sponsor_contacts
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id);
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error deleting addresses for sponsor_contacts');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --3. delete sponsors
 begin
 delete sponsors
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error deleting sponsors');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 --4. delete sponsor_contacts
 begin
 delete sponsor_contacts
 where sponsor_id = p_from_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 message('Error deleting sponsor_contacts');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;

 -- If everything is fine, display message
 :system.message_level := 10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if not form_failure then
 message('Sponsor Merged successfully'); pause;
 end if;

 if get_item_property('sp_name', enabled) = 'FALSE' then
 item_change('sp_name', 'E');
 end if;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
END;

RecordGroup.Name: SP_NAME_RG
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select name, sponsor_id
from sponsors
where status = 'A'
and name in (
select name
from sponsors
where :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, to_date(:local_date)+2)
and status='A'
and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
group by name
having count(*) > 1
)
order by name
